content: A diagnosis of gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) is established if any of the following plasma glucose thresholds are met or exceeded during the one-step oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) as recommended by the American Diabetes Association (ADA): Fasting plasma glucose level is greater than or equal to 92 mg/dL (5.1 mmol/L).0 mmol/L).5 mmol/L).
